plain: An organized system of government, or a state

webster.text: The form or constitution of civil government of a nation or state; and in free states, the frame or fundamental system by which the several branches of government are established, and the powers and duties of each designated and defined.

more.text: The constitution or general fundamental principles of government of any class of citizens, considered in an appropriate character, or as a subordinate state.

example.quote: The scheme of representation, as a substitute for a meeting of the citizens in person, being at most but very imperfectly known to ancient polity, it is in more modern times only that we are to expect instructive examples.
